(3) A top-down camera angle focuses on four hands rapidly striking the piano keys, showcasing intricate finger movements and synchronization. (4) The camera returns to a side-profile medium shot where the man and woman continue their discussion about the music book. The woman points at the pages while the man nods, both displaying high-arousal positive expressions with frequent eye contact and animated hand movements.
